name: Generic Profile: Raster band math
abstract: Derives a new raster from one or more input rasters via a user-supplied mathematical expression evaluated per pixel. One or more Raster inputs, an expression, one Raster output -- the output's band structure (one band or several) is not part of this signature, see its Implementation Profiles.
